messages.content: i will visit my aunt after i return my book. help me say the order.
return your book first, then visit your aunt.
what if she asks me to come before i return it?
you can tell her you need to return the book first.
write that in a kind way.
i would like to visit, but i need to return my book first.
did you change the first part of my plan?
no. you still return the book before the visit.
i have finished the letter i was writing to my grandmother.
how do you feel about having it done?
happy. i had been trying to find the right words all morning.
you kept trying and finished the letter.
can you just say one kind thing?
well done for finishing it.
thanks. i do not need another example.
you are welcome.
the shirt that i want is on the chair, not in the bag.
the shirt you want is on the chair.
there is another shirt in the bag. is that the one i chose?
no. you said the one you want is on the chair.
can you say it as a question to my brother?
could you please bring the shirt on the chair?
do not ask him to bring both.
could you please bring the shirt on the chair?
i have to wash the cups. does that mean i have washed them?
no. have to says you need to do it. have washed says it is done.
i washed them now. what can i say?
i have washed the cups.
what if i am still doing it?
i am washing the cups.
just the sentence where it is done.
i have washed the cups.
my friend and i will have lunch together. i want rice, and she would like soup.
you can eat together while having the food each of you would like.
i changed my mind. i want soup too.
now you both want soup.
did we stop our plan to eat together?
no. only your food changed.
just tell me what we both want now.
soup.
can you ask my sister to leave the window open?
could you please leave the window open?
now ask if she can close it instead.
could you please close the window?
did you keep it a question?
yes. it asks your sister to close the window.
just that question once more.
could you please close the window?
i had finished getting my bag ready before my father came. was it ready when he came?
yes. you said the bag was ready before he came.
does that say what was inside?
no. you only said the bag was ready.
i put a book and a coat in it. add that.
i had put a book and a coat in my bag before my father came.
just the two things in the bag.
a book and a coat.
i was going to read a little, but i read for a long time today.
you read for a long time instead of a little while.
yes. the story was good, and i kept reading.
you found a story that made you want to read more.
do not tell me i must read four tomorrow.
okay. you can choose tomorrow when you get there.
i just want to enjoy what i did today.
you can enjoy the reading you did today.
write do you know if my aunt is coming tomorrow.
do you know if my aunt is coming tomorrow?
now make it a question to my aunt.
are you coming tomorrow?
did the question become a sentence saying yes?
no. it still asks if she is coming.
just the question to my aunt.
are you coming tomorrow?
my sister was reading while my brother was drawing. who was drawing?
your brother.
did they have to do the same thing?
no. your sister was reading, and your brother was drawing.
write that with while at the start.
while my sister was reading, my brother was drawing.
just what my sister was doing.
reading.
explain return with a cup, not with a book.
to return a cup is to give the cup back.
can it also mean come back?
yes. a person can return by coming back to a place.
just use the cup in a sentence with return.
i will return your cup tomorrow.
do not add a sentence about a person coming home.
i will return your cup tomorrow.
i am waiting by the school. tell my father that.
i am waiting by the school.
add that my brother is with me.
i am waiting by the school with my brother.
did you say we are inside the school?
no. the note says by the school.
now ask him where he is.
where are you?
if it is warm, i will read in the garden. if it is cold, i will read inside.
you have a reading place for warm weather and one for cold weather.
it is cold today.
then your plan is to read inside.
did i say i would not read at all?
no. you said you would read inside if it is cold.
just the place for today.
inside.
i have not finished my note, but i know what i want to say.
what would you like the note to say?
i want to ask if my cousin can visit after lunch.
could you visit after lunch?
does that say he has already said yes?
no. it asks if he can visit.
can i use that as my note?
yes. it is a short question that says what you want to ask.
my aunt said she could not come today.
do you want help asking about another day?
yes. ask about tomorrow afternoon.
could you come tomorrow afternoon instead?
do not say she can come for sure.
could you come tomorrow afternoon instead?
what do we know about today?
your aunt said she could not come today.
fix this sentence: my brother and sister is at home.
my brother and sister are at home.
now make it about just my brother.
my brother is at home.
which word went back to is?
are changed to is when you said just your brother.
just the last sentence.
my brother is at home.
i will have cleaned my room before my friend comes, but i am still doing it now.
the room is not finished. you plan to finish before your friend comes.
i put my clothes away already.
that part is done. what part do you still want to do?
put the books on the shelf.
then the books still need to go on the shelf.
did i say the clothes are still on the floor?
no. you said you put them away.
write a sentence about a family having dinner.
the family sat together and had dinner.
now make it about tomorrow.
the family will sit together and have dinner tomorrow.
do you need to know my family to write that example?
no. it is an example, not a thing you said about your family.
just the example again.
the family will sit together and have dinner tomorrow.
i think my brother left his hat at school, but i am not sure. write that so it is not sure.
my brother may have left his hat at school.
did you say you know it is there?
no. may have is a way to say you are not sure.
now he said he found it at home.
then you can write: my brother found his hat at home.
just that last sentence.
my brother found his hat at home.
my sister and i have one camera together, but we each have our own book.
you share one camera, and each of you has a book.
how many books is that?
two books.
how many did i say we have together?
one camera.
does each have our own book mean one book for both of us?
no. it says each of you has a book of your own.
i was at home because i had work. put the reason first.
because i had work, i was at home.
does the new order say i had no work?
no. work is still the reason you were at home.
make it about tomorrow instead.
because i have work tomorrow, i will stay home.
just the part saying what i will do.
i will stay home.
i was worried before my visit, but i feel calm now.
it is good that you feel calm now.
i knew what to say once i got there.
you found your words when you were there.
can you just help me write that in a simple way?
i was worried before, but i felt calm when i knew what to say.
do not give me another plan.
okay.
ask my sister if she has to go home before dinner.
do you have to go home before dinner?
now make it about both of us.
do we have to go home before dinner?
did you change the time?
no. before dinner is still in the question.
just the question about us.
do we have to go home before dinner?
my mother was cooking while i was reading. say each part as a short sentence.
my mother was cooking. i was reading.
did you make one come after the other?
no. in your first sentence, they were happening at the same time.
now use while again.
my mother was cooking while i was reading.
who was reading?
you were.
would you like to come to my house and have lunch with me tomorrow? make that shorter.
would you like to have lunch with me tomorrow?
keep my house in it.
would you like lunch at my house tomorrow?
is it still a kind question?
yes. it asks the person to come and does not say they have to come.
just the short question.
would you like lunch at my house tomorrow?
the book that i need is the one on the table, not the one on the shelf.
you need the book on the table.
what is two and five?
seven.
now which book did i say i need?
the one on the table.
did the number question change the book?
no.
i will not go to the market tomorrow. does that mean i never go there?
no. it only says you will not go tomorrow.
write that i went yesterday too.
i went to the market yesterday, but i will not go tomorrow.
can both be true?
yes. going yesterday does not mean you have to go tomorrow.
just the part about yesterday.
i went to the market yesterday.
ask my father to tell me after lunch if he can visit.
could you please tell me after lunch if you can visit?
does that say he will answer for sure?
no. you are asking him to answer.
make it shorter but keep after lunch.
could you tell me after lunch if you can visit?
now add please again.
could you please tell me after lunch if you can visit?
hello. are you picoboi?
hello. yes, i am picoboi.
are you a person who can come to my house?
no. i am a model that runs in your browser.
can you still help me write a note?
i can try. what would you like the note to say?
just say your short name first.
pico.
write a short sentence saying i have finished my work.
i have finished my work.
now i really have finished it too.
then the sentence is true about what you did.
thanks. i am going to rest.
you are welcome. enjoy your rest.
that is all for now.
okay. goodbye.
